note: Per building type and per OSM tag, for the procedural Blender buildings (lane A). Footprint, shape, materials, orientation, setback and doors: North American towns only (the 17 site-study towns and the 12 North American storey-and-roof towns). storeys, roofShape, roofLevels, roofOrientation, height, eaveHeight, storeyHeight, roofPitchDeg: every town, each with n, the towns behind it (towns: {town: n}) and a split by region (na = North America, eu = the two German towns, used only for roof shapes per type and for pitch and eave where North America has no heights). A building takes its own tags, else those of its largest building:part. Eave = height - roof:height (flat roofs: the height). Pitch = roof:angle, else atan(roof:height / half span), the span being the footprint's short side (the long side with roof:orientation=across; the full span for skillions). "type:" keys are this study's business types (downtown_* = street-front commerce); "building:", "shop:", "amenity:", "craft:" keys are OSM tag values. Keys with fewer than 5 buildings are left out.
